auth.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with a number and a symbol.
auth.loginHint: Sign in to begin the rite. Your grimoire is bound to your account.
auth.registerHint: No account yet? Make one. It costs nothing and asks for nothing but an email.
auth.errorInvalid: That email and password did not match. Try again.
auth.errorExists: An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.errorWeak: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters, with a number and a symbol.
auth.errorGeneric: The gate would not open. Try again.

coldStart.heading: Name what you already love
coldStart.intro: The rite serves the unknown, but it needs a bearing first. Choose five bands you already know; their sound becomes the centre from which we drift outward.
coldStart.loadError: The list would not load. Try again.
coldStart.seedError: Your bearing could not be set. Try again.
coldStart.lastFmIntro: Fifteen years of scrobbles say more than five picks. If you have a Last.fm account, seed your taste from what you already play.
coldStart.lastFmUnavailable: Last.fm import is not available yet — the key that unlocks it is not in place. Choose bands above for now.
coldStart.lastFmNoMatch: None of your top artists is in the catalogue yet. Choose bands above instead.
coldStart.lastFmError: The import failed. Try again, or choose bands above.

search.heading: Search the grimoire
search.placeholder: Name a band. Darkthrone, Wardruna, Neurosis…
search.hint: Type at least two letters. Spelling need not be exact.
search.empty: Nothing answers to that name here. Try another spelling.
search.error: The grimoire would not open. Try again.
search.semanticHint: Describe a sound, not a name. "Something like Neurosis but slower."
search.semanticPlaceholder: Something like Neurosis but slower and heavier…
search.semanticError: The semantic engine is unavailable right now. Try searching by name.

artist.notFound: That page has been torn out. The band is not in the grimoire.
artist.error: The page would not load. Try again.
artist.noTags: No tags recorded. The margin is quiet here.
artist.noBio: No biography gathered. Nothing has been written about this band yet.
artist.noLineage: No lineage mapped yet. Shared members arrive with the Bloodline pass.
artist.noReleases: No releases recorded yet. The tape was never pressed.

rite.heading: The Rite
rite.subheading: A band, served blind. No name, no genre, no country, no cover — forty-five seconds. It is revealed only if you summon it.
rite.tasteError: Your taste could not be read. Try again.
rite.sliderLabel: Comfort to Abyss: how far from your taste to reach
rite.percentileWindow: Reaching the {{low}}th–{{high}}th percentile of distance from your taste.
rite.serveError: The rite would not begin. Try again.
rite.blindHint: No name until you decide. Judge by ear.
rite.audioError: This preview would not play. Invoke another.
rite.resolveError: That could not be recorded. Try again.
rite.whyNothingShared: Nothing overt connects it to your grimoire yet — this is the reach paying off.
rite.banishedBody: Cast out, and it stays blind — you judged it without knowing its name. It may return to the rite in six months.
rite.againBody: Skipped, neither summoned nor banished. Your taste is unchanged.
rite.emptyBody: Either you pushed the slider into the abyss and nothing servable lives that far out, or you have already invoked everything this close. Move the slider back, loosen the filters, or return later.

atlas.heading: The Atlas
atlas.intro: The whole catalogue as one sky. Each star is a band, placed by the sound of its embedding. Where you have a taste, the stars nearest you burn sulphur — and the dark between the clusters is the ground no band has claimed.
atlas.error: The sky would not load. Try again.
atlas.hint: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a star to open it
atlas.emptyBody: No band has been projected to the map yet. The Atlas fills in once the embeddings are placed.
atlas.noTasteAnon: Sign in and seed your taste to find yourself among the stars.
atlas.noTasteSignedIn: Seed your taste to find yourself among the stars.

grimoire.heading: Your grimoire
grimoire.error: Your grimoire would not open. Try again.
grimoire.emptyBody: Nothing summoned yet. Begin the rite and summon what you like — each one is inscribed here.

lineup.title: Lineup timeline
lineup.hint: Point at a release to light up who was in the band
lineup.emptyBand: No lineup traced yet. Member dates arrive when the band's people are gathered — the underground is thin here.
lineup.emptyPerson: No bands traced yet. This person's memberships have not been gathered.

graph.empty: No connections to draw. This node stands alone in the graph.
graph.hint: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a node to open it

lineage.error: The lineage would not load. Try again.
lineage.bloodlineHint: Shared members and declared influence. Click a node to open it.
lineage.diasporaHint: When this band broke up, its members scattered. Where each went next.
lineage.diasporaEmpty: No dated diaspora traced. Either nobody has left for a dated later band, or the members' next bands are not in the grimoire yet.
lineage.bandsEmpty: No memberships on record. This person's bands have not been gathered.
lineage.rabbitHoleHint: A guided walk down the lineage — each band leads to the next by a shared member or an influence.
lineage.rabbitHoleDeadEnd: The hole is shallow here — this band's neighbourhood runs out fast. Try one with more connections.
lineage.pageIntro: The blood and the network of the underground. Two questions that take two bands: how they connect, and what lives between them.
lineage.sixDegreesHint: The shortest chain of shared members connecting two bands.
lineage.noPath: No path connects these two in the graph we hold. They may be joined by members we have not gathered.
lineage.missingLinkHint: What lives between two bands? We take the midpoint of their sound and find its nearest neighbours.
lineage.noEmbedding: One or both of these bands has no embedding yet, so the space between them cannot be interpolated.
lineage.grimoireGraphHint: Only the bands you have summoned, and the blood between them. Click a node to open it.

scenes.heading: Scenes
scenes.intro: Metal grows in scenes, not countries. A city, a decade and a sound taken together — Gothenburg in the 90s, Tampa in the late 80s. Not a map of bands by country.
scenes.error: The scenes would not load. Try again.
scenes.empty: No scene has enough bands yet. The catalogue is thin here — the margin is quiet.

labels.heading: Labels
labels.intro: The door most people walk through. Trust a label — Peaceville, Earache, Nuclear Blast — and follow its roster into the dark.
labels.error: The labels would not load. Try again.
labels.empty: No label carries a release yet.

label.notFound: No such label in the grimoire.
label.error: The label would not load. Try again.
label.empty: No releases recorded on this label yet.

explore.heading: Explore
explore.intro: The catalogue turned over and looked at from odd angles: a wall of covers, two bands compared, the one-album bands, the relentless, and the split network.
explore.error: That would not load. Try again.
explore.wallHint: Album art from the Cover Art Archive. Click a cover to open its band.
explore.compareHint: Tag overlap, distance in sound, and the members they share.
explore.noDistance: no embedding for one of them
explore.oneAlbumHint: Said everything once and vanished — exactly one album, nothing else.
explore.oneAlbumEmpty: No one-album band in the catalogue yet.
explore.prolificHint: More releases than years alive. The projects that never stop.
explore.prolificEmpty: No hyperprolific band in the catalogue yet.
explore.splitsHint: Bands that shared one record. The real social graph of the underground. Click a node to open it.
explore.splitsEmpty: No split resolves both bands to the catalogue yet — most split partners are not in this corpus.

gift.heading: A gift, face down
gift.intro: Someone sent you a band, blind. Hear it without knowing what it is. Turn it over only if you like it.
gift.invalidBody: This link is not a valid gift, or it has been tampered with.
gift.revealHint: Decide by ear first. There is no taking it back.
gift.revealError: It would not turn over. Try again.
gift.giveHint: Send it face down and signed. They hear it blind, and it is revealed only if they like it.
gift.noPreview: This band has no preview, so it cannot be sent blind. A gift has to be able to sound.
gift.giveError: The gift could not be wrapped. Try again.
gift.linkHint: Whoever opens it hears the band blind, then may reveal it.

crossed.title: Crossed grimoires
crossed.hint: The Dark Twin, but with a friend you named. Share your code, paste theirs, and see what each of you has that the other lacks.
crossed.invalid: No grimoire answers to that code.
crossed.error: The grimoires would not cross. Try again.
crossed.theirsOnly: What they have that you lack
crossed.theirsEmpty: Nothing they summoned is missing from yours.
crossed.sharedEmpty: No band in both grimoires yet.
crossed.yoursOnly: What you have that they lack
crossed.yoursEmpty: Nothing you summoned is missing from theirs.

weekly.heading: The Weekly Rite
weekly.intro: Seven blind bands every ISO week. The same seven for everyone, until Monday. Subscribe and they reach you without opening the app.
weekly.pushHint: Get an alert when the weekly rite is ready. Delivery is real Web Push; it needs the browser's permission.
weekly.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications (or the page is not secure).
weekly.pushUnconfigured: Notifications are not configured on the server yet.
weekly.pushDenied: You blocked notifications. Enable them in your browser settings to subscribe.
weekly.notifyUnconfigured: Sending is unavailable: the server is missing its VAPID key.
weekly.notifyError: The notification could not be sent.
weekly.noTasteBody: The weekly rite needs your taste vector. Pick five bands to begin.
weekly.error: The weekly rite could not load. Try again.
weekly.emptyBody: There are not enough servable bands in the catalogue to form the weekly rite.
weekly.alreadyResolved: You already judged this one this week ({{state}}).

mirror.heading: The Mirror
mirror.intro: The app turns your own history back on you: what you say you like against what you rejected blind.
mirror.reflectionStatement: {{pct}}% of the bands you rejected blind ({{matching}} of {{total}}) belong to your favourite genre: {{tag}}.
mirror.reflectionEmpty: Not enough yet. Summon a few bands and banish others blind, and the mirror will tell you what your ear gives away.
mirror.trajectoryHint: How your taste has moved over time, drawn on the Atlas plane.
mirror.trajectoryEmpty: Your taste has not moved yet. Seed it and summon bands to trace the path.
mirror.trajectoryNotEnough: More than one point is needed to draw a trajectory.
mirror.trajectoryAria: Trajectory of your taste vector across the Atlas plane
mirror.antiRecHint: This band will repel you, and here is why. The closest one to what you have banished.
mirror.antiRecShared: It shares with what you rejected: {{tags}}.
mirror.antiRecEmpty: You have not banished anything yet. Banish a band blind and the mirror will know what repels you.
mirror.darkTwinHint: The user whose taste is closest to yours, yet whose collection is most disjoint. Anonymous.
mirror.darkTwinStats: Taste affinity {{similarity}}% · collections disjoint {{disjointness}}% · in common {{shared}}.
mirror.darkTwinTheirs: What they have and you lack
mirror.darkTwinEmpty: Not enough users have seeded a taste yet to find your dark twin.
mirror.gapsHint: Decades, countries and subgenres of the catalogue you have never summoned: the dark regions of the Atlas.
mirror.gapsNone: None: you have touched all of these.
mirror.gapsAtlasHint: These gaps are the empty regions of the Atlas.
